body.name: exact primitive-set projection
body.construction: Let \(Q_a\), \(S\), and \(C\) be the four Clopper--Pearson intervals. Define \[\widehat{\mathcal F}=\{(\widetilde q_0,\widetilde q_1,\widetilde u,\widetilde v):\widetilde q_a\in Q_a,\ \widetilde v\in S\cap[v_L,v_U],\ 1-\widetilde u\in C,\ \widetilde u\in[u_L,u_U],\ \widetilde u\le\widetilde q_a\le\widetilde v,\ \widetilde v-\widetilde u\ge\kappa\}.\] Define \(I_{\beta}\) as the interval image of \(\widehat{\mathcal F}\times[\theta_L,\theta_U]\) through the compatible-root construction.
